sourceDescription: Six user-supplied reference images. The sunburst buckle filename credits Matt Griffin. Original publications were not identified.

request.scope: The user requested the same cropped, recolorable logo-vector treatment for these six references: "do these as well".

preparation: The five flat icons use foreground alpha, caption removal, proportional cropping, asset-specific smoothing and a 4x bitmap trace. The shaded buckle was manually redrawn into clean contours in a 4x bitmap master before tracing. All six use Potrace and the Dune Zone normalization and authoring pipeline.
preview: The six-vector preview, including the simplified buckle redraw, was shown in chat before catalogue integration.
